translations.web: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.
translations.bsb: Now the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “Please take note that the place where we meet with you is too small for us.
translations.kjv: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.
translations.asv: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell before thee is too strait for us.
